description: Every evaluation of a strategy rule on recorded data, in order. The deflated Sharpe ratio (physics.json, ledger block) charges H1's held-out Sharpe for the number of counted trials. 'counted' means the run evaluated a rule on price data and could have informed a selection; cost variants of the same trades, benchmarks and predeclared-but-unrun hypotheses are listed but not counted. Sharpe ratios are the annualised daily figures of statistics.json where one exists; the cross-trial Sharpe variance that the expected maximum needs is estimated from the counted entries that have one (three, from different periods, one of them the held-out run itself), which is a weak basis and is disclosed in ADR-0008.
